data.name: Post Office: Tidy Up
data.detailed_description:
Post Office: Tidy Up is a cozy first-person game about sorting parcels. A huge post office is full of mess, and your job is to put every parcel back where it belongs.

The night the post magic failed

The post magic went wrong. In one night, 3,072 parcels fell off the shelves and covered the whole floor. The doors stay shut until the last one is back in its place. Just you, the mess, and all the time in the world.

Simple work, big result

Pick up a parcel. Look at the label. Walk to the right shelf. Put it in. That is the whole game.

Every parcel has one correct place. It clicks into the slot, turns its label to you, and one more gap in the shelf is gone. Little by little the floor comes back.

Read the label

Three things tell you where a parcel goes:

  • Logo — the city it is going to. 32 cities, each with its own crest.

  • Shape — the shelf it belongs to. 14 types, from a small envelope to a big box.

  • Number — the exact slot on that shelf.

Post magic

Fill shelves and you get to pick one card out of three. A card gives you new magic, or makes your old magic stronger.

  • Make parcels from the same shelf glow and rise out of the pile.

  • Light up the shelf you need, even through walls.

  • Pull parcels to your hands from far away.

  • Let a stack sort itself, then fly into the slots on its own.

You will not see every card in one run, so saying no to a card is a real choice.
